summary: Frontend-only e2e testing of Sweet'O Clock Product Detail Page. All 12 listed requirements passed. Home page loads, product card click navigates to /product/kaju-katli, gallery with 4 thumbnails swaps main image, qty + / - work (never below 1), add-to-cart label reflects price*qty (₹499 x 3 = ₹1497), nav-cart-count updates to 3, buy-now opens cart-drawer, pdp-reviews & pdp-suggestions render, suggested product click navigates and scrolls to top (scrollY=0), footer identical on PDP, checkout dialog opens and place-order shows order-success. Cart persists via localStorage (verified by count updates during navigation; count returns to 0 after successful order which is expected behaviour).
critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetail.jsx: 'about' section is rendered but there is no explicit data-testid for the reviews reel within pdp-reviews (only wrapper section has it) — minor, doesn't affect functionality.
getSuggestions returns first 4 non-matching products regardless of category — could later be improved to prefer same-category.
Cart is cleared after successful order (expected simulated behaviour); worth noting for testers verifying persistence AFTER checkout.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All PDP flows verified via playwright against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Testids used: product-card-<slug>, pdp-main-image, pdp-thumb-0..3, pdp-qty-inc/dec/value, pdp-add-to-cart, pdp-buy-now, nav-cart-count, cart-drawer, checkout-btn, checkout-dialog, checkout-name/phone/address/city/pincode, place-order-btn, order-success, site-footer, pdp-reviews, pdp-suggestions. Cart is cleared post-order — do not assume persistence after successful checkout.
